title: Restriction of canonical module base change to affine base opens
statement: Choose shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume the affine calculation: for every quasi-compact separated $f_0:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $g_0:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, relatively flat quasi-coherent $M$, and derived module pullback comparison $c_0$ on the chosen fibre square with additive tensor pullback, the canonical composite is invertible. Now let $f:X\to S$ be quasi-compact separated, $(g':X'\to X,f':X'\to S',f,g:S'\to S)$ cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], $G$ quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and flat over $S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], with additive tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $c$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For affine opens $V\subseteq S$, $W\subseteq S'$ with $W\subseteq g^{-1}V$, the exact derived restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] to $W$ of the canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by $Rf'_*(c)$ is invertible. The functors $L(-)^*$ and $R(-)_*$ are those of [def-pc-derived-pullback] and [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Construct U=f⁻¹(V), fA=(f restricted to V)≫V.isoSpec.hom, gA=W.isoSpec.inv≫g.resLE≫V.isoSpec.hom, and H=schemeOpenRestriction(X,U)(G). Mathlib supplies quasi-compactness and separatedness of fA; ordinary restriction preserves quasi-coherence and overFunctorEquiv transfers it to H. Apply the affine-open flatness theorem to H. Obtain tensor-pullback additivity from the tensor-pullback adjunction.

Use the arrow-level affine-chart comparison to obtain c0 with its comparison predicate and a commuting square with isomorphisms a,b. Apply the supplied haffine to fA,gA,H,c0. Derived direct image of W.isoSpec.inv maps this affine isomorphism to an isomorphism in D(W). Postcompose the square equality with b.inv, cancel b.hom≫b.inv, and rewrite the restricted original arrow as a.hom≫T(affine composite)≫b.inv. Every factor is invertible.

theorem canonicalModuleBaseChange_isIso_on_affine_open_of_affine_cases
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (haffine : ∀ {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (_ : Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver G f)
    (c : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj G))
    (_ : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison (pullback.fst f g) G c),
    IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map c))
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (hflat : Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver G f)
    (c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison g' G c)
    (V : S.affineOpens) (W : S'.affineOpens) (hWV : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
    IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction S' W.1).mapDerivedCategory.map
      (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map c))
